dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG RUSTDESK_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="RustDesk" \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    NO_FULL=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/rustdesk-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  if [ -z ${RUSTDESK_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    RUSTDESK_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/rustdesk/rustdesk/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/rustdesk.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/releases/download/${RUSTDESK_VERSION}/rustdesk-${RUSTDESK_VERSION}-$(uname -m).deb" && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/rustdesk.deb && \
  apt-get install -y xdg-user-dirs && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /root/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

# Added

# Fixes

- [fix(macos): turn privacy mode off before locking at session end #16729](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16729)
- [fix(flutter): keep Windows accept window side panels on the current monitor #16855](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16855)

- [fix(linux): serve a greetd Wayland login screen over DRM #16894](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16894)
- [fix(macos): launch the service daemon directly instead of through sh #16879](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16879)
- [fix: block sensitive config options in strategy updates #16696](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16696)
- [fix(windows): continue removal after configuration sync errors #16865](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16865)
- [fix(drm): stop re-encoding a still screen #16888](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16888)
- [fix(windows): retry service IPC before terminating the GUI #16913](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16913)
- [Fix/windows installer directory guard #16908](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16908)
- [fix(audio): look up the named audio input among input devices only #16906](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16906)
- [fix(windows): write the clipboard owner marker first #16695](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16695)
- [fix(server): ignore spaces around IP whitelist entries #16692](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16692)
- [Fix/windows ipc server auth #16755](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16755)
- [Fix/windows installer temp junction #16871](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16871)
- [fix(android): prevent crash on large clipboard payload (>1MB) #16767](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16767)
- [fix(sciter): avoid double DPI scaling of main window minimum size #16824](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16824)
- [fix(ios): follow system dark mode on launch screen #16816](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16816)
- [fix(android): copy captured frames before the Image is released #16827](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16827)
- [fix(lang): pick Hebrew and Indonesian from legacy Android locale codes #16882](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/pull/16882)
- [fix(wayland): pass on an unclassified capture error instead of "x11 expected" beeeef14](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk/commit/beeeef14f0a61bd622aacf042b4396bdeaed9b61)


</details>
